_doc_truoc: BANG VIEC cho qwen chay may ngay lien. Sua file nay la sua viec cua may.
Truong bat buoc: ma, ten, lan, uu_tien, ngay, lenh (hoac soan_ma), cong.
lan     TESTER | CPU | LLM | MANG | NHE     -> quyet dinh chay song song bao nhieu
uu_tien 1 la lam truoc. Cung uu tien thi theo `ngay` roi theo thu tu file.
phu_thuoc  danh sach `ma` phai XONG truoc.
cong    do `qwen/cong.py` cham bang CODE. qwen KHONG duoc tu phan DAT.
lap     so lan chay lai toi da (mac dinh 1). Dung cho vong lap doc/boc.
can_nguoi  true = KHONG tu chay, chi hien ra cho chu du an.
RANG BUOC VAT LY - khong duoc pha:
lan TESTER toi da 1 viec. `chay_tester_kho` ghi de CUNG mot file
MQL5/Experts/<TEN_EA>.mq5 + cung mot .ini + cung mot .xml, va chi co MOT
terminal64.exe. Hai viec tester chay cung luc thi ket qua cua nhau bi
ghi de, va khong ai bao loi - dung y het mot ket qua that.

viec.ten: Do dia truoc khi cho tester chay - bay B4 cua 08/09
viec.vi_sao: Tester treo 2 gio, tieu 12 giay CPU, log ghi 'low disk space'. C: chi con 13,4 GB. Do TRUOC moi phien tester, dung doi no treo roi moi doan.
lenh: import shutil,sys,json,pathlib; u=shutil.disk_usage('C:/'); g=u.free/1e9; print('C: free %.2f GB'%g); pathlib.Path('reports/QWEN_DIA.json').write_text(json.dumps({'dong':[{'o':'C','gb':round(g,2)},{'o':'F','gb':round(shutil.disk_usage('F:/').free/1e9,2)}]}),encoding='utf-8'); sys.exit(0 if g>6 else 3)
viec.ghi_chu: Thoat ma 3 = con duoi 6 GB. KHONG duoc tu xoa AppData\Local\Google (13,7 GB) hay Apple Computer (5,7 GB) - do la du lieu cua chu du an, phai hoi.

viec.ten: qwen doc toan van + boc co che den het ton kho (dot 1)
viec.vi_sao: Day la viec DUNG de giao cho may: khoi luong thuan, loi bi `them_co_che` chay tren du lieu that bat lai. 6.970/7.297 tai lieu chua khai thac.
viec.ghi_chu: Neu log ra 'ung vien 0 NHUNG kho con N tai lieu chua doc' thi day la KHAU DOC HONG, khong phai het ton kho. Bao ngay, dung chay tiep.

viec.ten: qwen boc co che tu 190 file CHI BAO (hang doi KHAC L2)
viec.vi_sao: Chay SONG SONG duoc voi L2 vi no doc danh sach file .mq5 CHI BAO, con L2 doc bang `tai_lieu` - hai hang doi khac nhau, khong gianh nhau ban ghi. Va 190/389 file ma la CHI BAO, chua tung vao khau boc ('70%' that ra la 32%).
viec.ghi_chu: File nao tra RONG thi thu lai bang qwen3.6-flash (yield cao hon). Va kiem `completion_tokens` co sat tran khong truoc khi ket luan mo hinh kem - max_tokens thap lam mo hinh bi cat giua chung roi ra 0, doc y het 'mo hinh kem'.

viec.ten: Dao chieu + ghep tren GER40Cash
viec.vi_sao: Nut that da truy den tan cung: loi the ghep den tu chan NGUOC CHIEU, ma trong 60 chan duong tot nhat chi 4 chan la chieu BAN. Dao chieu la co may DUY NHAT dang sinh chan ban (129 co che am -> 38 chan duong). Moi chay cho US100/US500/US30.

viec.ten: Dao chieu + ghep tren UK100Cash
viec.vi_sao: Nhu V1_dao_GER40.
viec.ghi_chu: UK100 mua-giu -2,77%/nam. Chi so 'em' khong dong nghia voi de an - 2/3 chi so em nhat AM sau phi.

viec.ten: Cham lai cap tren train + doc holdout (KHONG ton tester)
viec.vi_sao: Chay duoc SONG SONG voi lan tester vi no doc duong von da co. Day la cach lap day CPU trong khi terminal64 dang ban.

viec.ten: Ghep cheo tai san (KHONG ton tester)
viec.vi_sao: Cung ho voi P1: an CPU chu khong an terminal64.

viec.ten: Do tinh cach tai san (Hurst) cho cac ma vua chay
viec.vi_sao: Hurst du bao duoc (r=-0,567 tren 157 ma); VR(2) va ac1 VO DUNG. Do truoc de biet ma nao dang dao chieu.

viec.ten: Placebo rong cho chan dao chieu tren 4 ma
viec.vi_sao: 38 chan dao chieu moi qua train+holdout, CHUA qua placebo. Chua qua placebo thi khong duoc goi la phat hien. Mot ma khong du: 5 co che 'manh tren US100' chet sach khi kiem cheo.

viec.ten: Bat DAT HUE vao cap ra tien
viec.vi_sao: Trong 6 co che quan tri vi the chi dat hue song sot (+4,8% lai, sut giam khong doi). No mien phi nen khong co ly do khong bat. CAM trailing (-68%), nhoi lenh (chay tai khoan ngoai mau), he so lot > 1,0.

viec.ten: qwen doc + boc dot 2 (sau khi dot 1 xong)
viec.vi_sao: Mot lan doc roi mot lan boc khong vet duoc kho - phai lap. Do 08/09: 24/24 loi goi qwen dong thoi deu OK.

viec.ten: Do lai nhan/ma_nguon.py - MQL5 Code Base tai 0 file
viec.vi_sao: Do la nguon DUY NHAT co file chay tester duoc ngay. Chien dich 08/09 tai 0 file du kiem_mang bao OK -> gan chac la khau tai hong chu khong phai nguon rong.
viec.ghi_chu: MQL5 bi chan vi DNS - bat Cloudflare WARP truoc (`b mang`). Neu tai 0 file thi do TUNG CHANG, dung ket luan 'nguon rong'.

viec.ten: Do suat boc theo LOP NGUON (reddit_td / hackernews / habr dang 0%)
viec.vi_sao: Ba lop nguon deu 0/60. Cung ho loi B3: mau ma nguon gia dinh co LENH (`strategy.entry`, `OrderSend`), nen thu vien chi bao chi 0 diem. Da sap 3 lan cung ho nay - DO truoc khi ket luan 'nguon rac'.

viec.ten: TAI M1 VE MT5 (viec cua chu du an - can giao dien)
viec.vi_sao: Model=0/4 can M1, ma may chi co M1 tu 2026-05-28. Mot luot 10 nam ton 19,5 phut roi tra bang RONG. Khong tai duoc bang dong lenh.
viec.ghi_chu: Mo MT5 -> Tools -> Options -> Charts -> Max bars; roi mo bieu do M1 cua US100Cash va keo ve qua khu. Xong thi `q xong M1_tai_du_lieu`.

viec.ten: Lenh stop hai dau (gia thuyet #2 - breakout grid)
viec.vi_sao: Ca 664 co che trong kho deu la tin hieu VAO. Kho da thu 61 hedge / 43 luoi / 43 DCA / 34 recovery ma 0 cai vao duoc thu vien. Day la ho co che THU HAI chua tung do.
viec.ghi_chu: Neu co cau hinh duong o Model=0 thi BAT BUOC chay lai Model=4 truoc khi tin - TP nho hon bien do nen la ca xau nhat cua bay Model=1 (che ra lai gia 12 lan).

viec.ten: Doi chung EA switch vs EA nhieu-slot tren D1 voi 40 slot
viec.vi_sao: RUI RO LON NHAT CON DE LAI. Cung 36 chan, cung phep doi khung, o H1: nhieu-slot cho 6/36 duong / -4.739; switch cho 22/36 / +2.179. Tren D1 voi 3 slot thi hai duong khop chinh xac. MOI con so ghep hien co deu dua tren duong von tu EA nhieu-slot.
viec.ghi_chu: Chua co script. Doc `nhan/dich_mq5_ghep.py` va `nhan/dich_mq5.py`, viet ban nhap ra qwen/nhap/, roi chu du an duyet moi chay.
